class.name: LightmapStreamData
class.description: [LightmapStreamData] refers to a [code].lmstream[/code] file baked by [LightmapGI] when [member LightmapGI.streaming_enabled] is [code]true[/code]. The file stores each baked instance's lightmap rectangle with its own mipmaps, compressed to BC6H. Only the file's index is kept in memory; mipmaps are read from the file as they are streamed in.
